```{r,include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read_csv("train_update.csv")
set.seed(900)
na.omit(data)

data<-cbind(data,as.numeric((data$Date-data$`Lay date`)/365))

colnames(data)[12] <- "Years"

data<-cbind(data,sqrt((data$`GPS y2`-data$`GPS y1`)^2 +
                        (data$`GPS x2`-data$`GPS x1`)^2))
colnames(data)[13] <- "Length"
head(data)
```
```{r,include = FALSE}
sf1 <- 0.7
sf2 <- 0.15
library(ggplot2)
#  Logic:
#    1. randomly permute (reorder) numbers 1,2,...,n
#    2. take positions of first 70% as training set "set=1"
#    3. take positions of next 15% as validation set "set=2"
#    4. take positions of last 15% as test set "set=3
reorder <- sample.int(n = nrow(data), size = nrow(data), replace = FALSE)

set <- ifelse(test = (reorder < sf1 * nrow(data)), yes = 1,
  no = ifelse(test = (sf1 * nrow(data) < reorder & reorder < (sf1 + sf2) 
                * nrow(data)), yes = 2, no = 3
  )
)
val <- data[set == 2,]
fit1 <- lm(Years~Surface+Material+Length+`GPS x1`+`GPS x2`+`GPS y1`+`GPS y2`, data=data[set==1,])
fit2 <- lm(Years~Surface+Material+Length, data=data[set==1,])

pred_v_s1 <- predict(fit1, newdata = val)
MSPE_v_s1 <- mean((as.numeric(val$Years) - pred_v_s1)^2)
pred_v_s2 <- predict(fit2, newdata = val)
MSPE_v_s2 <- mean((as.numeric(val[,12])- pred_v_s2)^2)
summary(fit1)
summary(fit2)
#ggplot(data=val) +geom_point(mapping=aes(x=pred_v_s1, y=as.numeric(Years),
        #colour=Material))+ geom_abline(a=0,b=1)+
#labs(x="Predicted # Years Before Breaking", y="Actual # Years before breaking")

```
```{r}
set.seed(4520333)
fold <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = nrow(data)))
formulas <- list(num1 = Years ~Surface+Material+Length+`GPS x1`+`GPS x2`+`GPS y1`+`GPS y2`,num2 = Years~Surface+Material+Length,prevbest = Years~ Surface+Material+Length+`Lay date`,newbest=Years~ (Surface*Material)+Length+`Lay date`,newtest=Years~ (Surface*Material)+`Lay date`)
mspe <- function(actual, predicted) mean((actual - predicted)^2)
cv_results <- tibble(fold = integer(), model = character(), MSPE = double())
forcv <-matrix(data=0,nrow=5,ncol=5)

for (k in 1:5) {
  cv_train <- data[fold != k, ]
  cv_valid <- data[fold == k, ]
  counts<-1

  for (model_name in names(formulas)) {
    
    fit <- lm(formulas[[model_name]], data = cv_train)
    predicted <- predict(fit,cv_valid)
    forcv[counts,k]<-mspe(cv_valid$Years, predicted)
    cv_results <- add_row(
      cv_results,
      fold = k,
      model = model_name,
      MSPE = mspe(cv_valid$Years, predicted)
    )
    counts<-counts+1
  }
}
mean(na.omit(forcv[1,]))
mean(na.omit(forcv[2,]))
mean(na.omit(forcv[3,]))
mean(na.omit(forcv[4,]))
mean(na.omit(forcv[5,]))
cv_results
```

```{r}
#fit summaries

    print(summary(fit))
}
```

```{r}
fit_interaction <- lm(Years~(Surface*Material)+Length+`Lay date`, data=data[set==1,])
fit3 <- lm(Years~Surface+Material+Length+`Lay date`, data=data[set==1,])
pred_v_s3 <- predict(fit3, newdata = val)
pred_int <-predict(fit_interaction, newdata = val)
MSPE_v_s3 <- mean((as.numeric(val[,12])- pred_v_s3)^2)
```

```{r}
bestfit <- lm(Years~Surface+Material+Length+`Lay date`, data=data)
data2 <- read_csv("STAT440Project1_files/Train_update3.csv")
na.omit(data2)
#data that havent leaked and arent polyurethane
data2nl <- filter(data2,Leaked=="0"& Material!="polyurethane")
pred <- predict(bestfit, newdata = data2nl)
ggplot(data=data2nl) +geom_point(mapping=aes(x=Age, y=pred,
      colour=Material))+ geom_abline(a=0,b=1)+labs(x=
        "Age", y="Predicted # Years before breaking")
data2nl <-cbind(data2nl,(pred-data2nl$Age))
colnames(data2nl)[13]<-"yrs2leak"
```

```{r}

ggplot(data2nl) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = `GPS x1`, y = `GPS y1`, xend = `GPS x2`, yend = `GPS y2`, 
        color = yrs2leak),
    linewidth = 3, lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `GPS x1`, y = `GPS y1`), color = "grey30", size = 0.2) +  
  geom_point(aes(x = `GPS x2`, y = `GPS y2`), color = "grey30", size = 0.2) +  
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "red", high = "forestgreen",
    name = "Years until\nexpected leak"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Pipe network by leak risk", x = "X", y = "Y") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
data2nl$is_iron <- ifelse(grepl(" iron",data2nl$Material), "Iron", "Not iron")

ggplot(data2nl) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = `GPS x1`, y = `GPS y1`, xend = `GPS x2`, yend = `GPS y2`, 
        color = is_iron),
    linewidth = 2, lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `GPS x1`, y = `GPS y1`), color = "grey30", size = 0.2) +  
  geom_point(aes(x = `GPS x2`, y = `GPS y2`), color = "grey30", size = 0.2) +  
  scale_color_manual( values = c("Iron" = "firebrick", "Not iron" = "steelblue"),
    name = "Material") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Pipe network by Material", x = "X", y = "Y") +
  theme_minimal()

```
